position.title: Banner position
position.description: A bar at the top or bottom, a dialog in the center, or a small box in a bottom corner.

privacyUrl.title: Privacy policy link
privacyUrl.description: Where your privacy policy is: a web address or a path on your website, for example /privacy.

askAgainMonths.title: Ask again after (months)
askAgainMonths.description: How long a visitor’s choice holds before the banner asks again (1–24 months). Many privacy authorities expect at most 12.
